✨ avoid-ai-writing | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the human-like quality of AI-generated text by identifying and correcting AI writing patterns, making content more natural and less detectable as machine-generated.
✨ Key Features: • Audits and rewrites content to remove AI writing patterns • Supports detect-only and edit-in-place modes • Includes optional voice profiles (casual, professional, technical, warm, blunt)
📖 Summary: This JavaScript skill audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns, making text sound more human. It supports multiple modes like detection-only, full rewrite, and in-place editing, along with customizable voice profiles.
